reviews.title: good MB just needs extra work with software install.
reviews.comment: So far it is a good MB. Had to load drivers after the operating system was installed with out going on line with MS. Once installed was able to then use the txt files to install drivers and finish the updates and driver installation. Since then rule operating system is more stable than before with a ROG MB.
reviews.author: acpat

reviews.title: Just buy it works perfectly first time
reviews.comment: I love this MB it is the first one out of three different ones that I purchased and the only one that works perfectly.  I installed it and it booted up perfectly the first time.  It has pretty much all the features of a really high end board.  If you are looking to put together a computer or just want an upgrade I highly recommend this MB.  For background I have been building and repairing computers for over 40years in fact I used to do it for a living years ago until the price dropped to the bottom.  I use to get as much as 5000.00 dollars per build so if you think these prices are high I got some news for you they are a bargain.  And AMAZON is the best place to purchase your parts as the others will leave you hanging if there is a problem.  I highly recommend this board and MSI makes some of the best quality parts and components in the world.
